root.label: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor moves out of Royal Lodge

events.label: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor moves out of Royal Lodge
Royal Lodge lease ends and Crown Estate receives £1.5m settlement

slots.name: dilapidations penalty
slots.sentence: There was a total £1.8m penalty for the "dilapidations" to Royal Lodge, but that has been reduced by the £300,000 Mountbatten-Windsor would have received for an early surrender of his lease.

slots.name: upfront repairs
slots.sentence: When Andrew had taken on the 75 year lease in 2003, he had made considerable up-front payments, including about £7.5m for repairs, which meant that he did not have to pay a monthly rent.

slots.name: compensation period
slots.sentence: It also meant that if he gave up the lease within the first 25 years he would be legally entitled to some compensation - with that amount reducing each year.

slots.name: refund amount
slots.sentence: Leaving in October 2026 would have meant that the Crown Estate would have had to pay him back about £302,000.
